result.brief: 提出多 token 预测、token 级对比正则与语义丢弃的 AR 图像生成训练框架，提升表征判别性并加速训练。
result.reason: AR image generation training framework with multi-token prediction and token-level contrastive representation regularization; image-only, no explicit video transfer, but representation discriminability is a plausible enabling link.
